title: eval-harness: add CI hooks for prompt-set regression & quality gating
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: add infra-level CI hooks that run prompt-set regressions and quality gating as part of PR checks for model-serving changes. This centralizes eval checks used by the eval-harness repo and makes gating consistent across model onboarding and runtime changes.

Changes in this PR: checklist and summary
- Add GitHub Actions job 'eval-harness/prompt-regression' that: runs a lightweight subset of prompt-sets, uploads metrics to the eval metrics service, and fails the job when quality thresholds are breached.
- Implement reusable workflow file .github/workflows/eval-prompt-regression.yml for easy inclusion by other repos (redwood, redwood-model-registry, redwood-helm-charts).
- Add an opt-in per-PR marker (LABEL: run-eval-harness) for heavy runs to avoid blocking trivial documentation/docs-only PRs.
- Integrate result status with PR checks and add clear failure message with links to metric diffs and offending prompts.
- Update eval-harness CLI to return non-zero exit codes for regression gates and emit a compact JSON summary for CI to parse.

Commits (high-level):
- 9a7b3e2: feat(ci): add reusable eval prompt regression workflow
- b4c21f0: feat(eval-cli): exit non-zero on gating failures + compact summary output
- c3d56a1: docs: describe how to opt-in and interpret CI failures
- e2f78d4: test(ci): add smoke test that runs a 2-prompt local harness in GH Actions

Files changed (high-level):
- .github/workflows/eval-prompt-regression.yml (new) -- reusable workflow that pulls eval-harness docker image, runs selected prompt-sets, posts results.
- tools/eval_harness/ci_runner.py (modified) -- parse CLI output, upload to metrics, set exit codes. Small snippet: "def run_gates(results): if results['regressions'] > 0: sys.exit(2)"
- eval-harness/runner/quicksets/basic_prompts.json (new) -- lightweight prompt set used by CI smoke runs.
- docs/developer/eval-ci.md (modified) -- instructions and runbook for failures.
- tests/ci/test_eval_hook.sh (new) -- GH Actions smoke integration test.

CI summary: initial run (main CI) failed due to CLI exit-code behavior; fixed in follow-up commit b4c21f0 which added proper exit handling and unit tests. Final CI status: pass. Full run logs available at: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/546781 (internal).

Review conversation (summary):
- Ethan Park (reviewer): requested clearer failure messages pointing to the exact prompt and metric that violated the gate. Suggested adding a compact JSON blob in the check details for easier automation.
- Maya Chen (author): implemented reviewer feedback in b4c21f0; added a "failure_summary.json" artifact with offending prompts and metric diffs.
- Riley Singh (reviewer): asked for an opt-out/opt-in mechanism for noisy repos; recommended label-based opt-in for heavy runs. Implemented.
- Ava Martinez (approver): ran the smoke workflow on a fork and approved once the smoke test passed and messaging was clear.

Tests: unit tests for eval CLI exit codes and parser added; GH Actions workflow includes a smoke test that runs the basic_prompts.json set on a small dockerized model.

Merge: squash and merge. Post-merge actions: automated rollout of reusable workflow to the actions marketplace in our org and a follow-up task to add a longer nightly run gating larger prompt-sets.

Notes for operators: this change intentionally fails PRs that introduce regressions in the CI prompt-sets. Use LABEL: run-eval-harness to trigger heavier runs during model onboarding. See docs/developer/eval-ci.md for remediation steps.
release_notes: Add CI hooks and reusable GH workflow for prompt-set regression checks and quality gating; opt-in label for heavy runs; eval CLI exit codes updated to gate failures.
